messages:
alex.k: Quick heads-up: I need to swap my 14:00 PT deploy due to a Dr appt. Can someone take the 14:00 slot? I can do the 17:00 one instead.
mira: I can take 14:00. Can you confirm the canary ratio and smoke checklist? I also have a rollout-config PR that's not merged.
alex.k: PR #4824 is pending sam's review. Canary plan: 2% -> 10% over 30m. Smoke checklist: healthcheck, latency dashboard, DB replica read test.
alex.k: Canary config snippet:
```
canary:
  start: 2%
  step_to: 10%
  window: 30m
rollback_tag: v1.12.3-rollback
```
sam: On it, will review in ~20m. @deploy-bot can you hold the train until PR is merged?
deploy-bot: hold created for train-2026-03-18 (meta: 4311112222). Use /deploy release-train --force to override.
harper: If Mira takes 14:00, who owns rollback for that slot? Alex, you'll own 17:00 rollback?
alex.k: I'll own 17:00 rollback. For 14:00 Mira, please set rollback tag to v1.12.3-rollback and keep canary at 2% for the first 10m.
mira: Got it. Will merge after Sam approves. Do we want a full smoke or a shallow smoke? Prefer to avoid writes.
sam: Shallow smoke only: read checks + trace span verify. I'll ping when merged.
mira: Merged and CI green. Assigning 14:00 to me. cc: @harper
deploy-bot: PR merged, hold released. 14:00 slot assigned to mira. Canary scheduled.
mira: :thumbsup: Starting preflight at :30 (10m before). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-train-preflight
harper: I'll watch latency dashboard and KV cache hit rate during canary.
alex.k: Thanks. I'll be on call for 17:00 rollback if needed. Leave rollback notes in the runbook.
mira: Preflight OK: services responding, DB replica read OK, feature flag toggled for canary. Launching canary now.
deploy-bot: Canary started (2% -> 10% over 30m) for release-train-63. Paging threshold: error rate > 2%.
harper: No error spike, p50 stable.
sam: Merge + shallow smoke look good. Alex, before your 17:00 run, run `./scripts/check-kv.sh`.
alex.k: Will do. Rollback tag created: v1.12.3-rollback. If rollback happens, notify #incidents.
mira: Canary passed first 10m, promoting to 10%.
deploy-bot: Canary promoted. All checks passing.
harper: LGTM. I'll stay until 18:00 PT to confirm post-promotion metrics.
alex.k: Thanks team — updating release-train sheet now. Good luck :tada:
